text: Guyot Environnement, the Stade Brestois 29 chest sponsor, is a Breton waste-services group (SIREN 430004671, SAS, Brest, about 300 employees) whose Président de SAS is the holding Hiru Environnement (SIREN 943903278, created 2026-01-01), itself chaired by Erwan Guyot with Giulia Guyot as Directrice Générale — the Guyot family; the club's partner page names Guyot Erwan as the group's Président. No state or sovereign-fund stake was found in the chain.
short: Groupe Guyot Environnement is chaired by the Guyot family holding Hiru Environnement.

source.name: Annuaire des entreprises (recherche-entreprises.api.gouv.fr), SIREN 943903278
source.note: Same response: GUYOT Giulia Edwige Joëlle is Directrice Générale; nature juridique 5710 (SAS), created 2026-01-01, siège 15 rond-point des Grèbes, Brest. The registry response for GUYOT ENVIRONNEMENT (430004671) lists HIRU ENVIRONNEMENT as its Président de SAS.
